findings.impact: Any push - including the current 53-file uncommitted redesign landing in one commit - reaches production users without typecheck, build proof, tests (none exist), or a human decision; combined with no rollback doc this makes every deploy irreversible-by-vibe.
findings.fix: Set Render autoDeploy: false and Vercel git deployment checks to require the CI workflow, then add a manual promote step (or required status check); document the revert command per service in RENDER_DEPLOYMENT.md.
findings.verify: rg -c autoDeploy render.yaml expects >=1 explicit setting
